findings.source_quote: "Is any merry? Let him sing psalms" (James 5:13).
findings.suggested_fix: Remove or adjust the added intensifier so the translation more closely follows the plain sense of the English quote. Suggested wording: «Se qualcuno è allegro, canti salmi» (preserve existing HTML and punctuation).
findings.translation_quote: «Se qualcuno è veramente allegro, canti salmi» (Giacomo 5:13).

findings.source_quote: "Now this should all seem plain enough to understand and easy enough to do but, alas, we find we have a constant and persistent adversary who seeks to thwart our song. We are not unaware of his devices..."
findings.suggested_fix: The English phrase 'We are not unaware of his devices' means 'we know of his devices'. The translation reads 'Non ignoreremo i suoi artifici...' which reads as a future refusal to ignore rather than a present acknowledgment. Recommend: «Non siamo ignari dei suoi artifici...» to match the English sense. Preserve HTML tags.

findings.source_quote: Psalm 137:2-4 and Jeremiah 29:5-7 appear in English with a specific structure in the source.
findings.suggested_fix: The translation renders the quoted verses in Italian paraphrase and in the Jeremiah case expands into a longer, more literal Italian NIV/DR-style quotation. While not doctrinally wrong, ensure the rendering preserves the concise phrasing and verse boundaries of the original English as printed. Suggested adjustment: render Psalm 137:2-4 and Jeremiah 29:5-7 in Italian that closely mirrors the sentence breaks and balance of the English source (keeping the current HTML structure).
findings.translation_quote: "«Appendemmo le nostre cetre ai salici, infatti là quelli che ci rapirono richiedevano da noi un canto, e quelli che ci depredavano richiedevano da noi allegria, dicendo: Cantateci uno dei canti di Sion. Come canteremo il canto del Signore in terra straniera?» (Salmo 137:2-4). ... «Costruite case e abitatele; piantate giardini e mangiatene il frutto. Prendete mogli e generate figli e figlie; prendete figlie per i vostri figli e date le vostre figlie in marito, affinché abbondino e non diminuiscano. Cercate la pace della città dove io vi ho fatti deportare e pregate il Signore per essa; perché nella sua pace avrete pace» (Geremia 29:5-7)."
